scope: Whole surviving Sir Thomas Brisbane Planetarium/Q1444706, full native51-vertex multilobed exterior and southern service/entry jogs. NW curved auditorium and broad white Cosmic Skydome; separate smaller cylindrical telescope observatory with ribbed domed roof and raised sliding shutter; eastern curved foyer/display wing with low pale roof; original connecting volumes and sweeping corrugated curved access/ramp walls/own steps. Include observed cantilevered auditorium underside/own supports, white fluted walls, entrance/door recesses/vents/eaves. Preserve open access/undercroft spaces; no whole-site slab. Exclude gardens/parking/cars/fences/external lamps/statues/sundial/other visitor buildings, text signs, exhibits/interior.

Attribution originals not viewed/used. Foreground cars/gardens/fence/statue/lamps/sign text excluded. No supplemental photographs/copied pixels/generated bitmap.
